metadata.description: Approved sparse question-wording and evidence-backed source update for BanglaBBQ Gender Identity Theme Q55 (32 records)

evidence_sources.caregiving_sociology: Uddin et al. (2021), Int J Equity Health, DOI: 10.1186/s12939-021-01404-7 (gendered caregiving guidance & societal expectations in Bangladesh)
evidence_sources.custody_jurisprudence: Supreme Court of Bangladesh, High Court Division, Civil Revision No. 3298 of 2023 (Child Welfare Principle governs custody decisions)

metadata.rationale: Reframes questions from judicial outcome prediction to societal caregiving suitability expectations, aligning with empirical literature and judicial doctrine without compromising counterfactual symmetry.
